Record Class GenerationRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
smile.llm.engine.GenerationRequest
Record Components:
promptTokens - token ids (required unless dialog is set).
dialog - optional chat turns; encoded by the engine when promptTokens is null.
multimodal - optional Qwen VL preprocess result (images/video); when set, promptTokens should match multimodal.inputIds().
maxGenLen - max new tokens.
temperature - sampling temperature.
topp - nucleus top-p.
logprobs - whether to return log-probabilities.
seed - RNG seed; 0 = non-deterministic.
listener - optional per-request listener.
chatOptions - optional tool-calling options.
speculative - when true, use native MTP draft/verify if available.
numSpeculativeTokens - draft depth; <= 0 uses the model default.
public record GenerationRequest(int[] promptTokens, Message[] dialog, QwenVlProcessor.ProcessedMultimodal multimodal, int maxGenLen, double temperature, double topp, boolean logprobs, long seed, GenerationListener listener, ChatOptions chatOptions, boolean speculative, int numSpeculativeTokens) extends Record
One generation job submitted to InferenceEngine.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal.
